words.meaning: literal: for the token to drop; real: to get it / realize suddenly
words.example: Când am văzut totalul, mi-a picat fisa.
words.exampleMeaning: When I saw the total, I finally got it.

words.meaning: literal: to kick with the foot; real: to waste or squander an opportunity
words.example: Nu da cu piciorul unei șanse bune.
words.exampleMeaning: Do not throw away a good chance.

words.meaning: literal: to make a stallion from a mosquito; real: to exaggerate
words.example: Nu face din țânțar armăsar pentru o greșeală mică.
words.exampleMeaning: Do not exaggerate over a small mistake.

words.meaning: literal: to walk around with a painted crow; real: to deceive or pass off something false
words.exampleMeaning: The seller was trying to deceive people.

words.meaning: literal: to take it astray; real: to go off track or lose control
words.example: După atâta stres, el a luat-o razna.
words.exampleMeaning: After so much stress, he lost control.

words.meaning: literal: to beat water in a mortar; real: to talk pointlessly or repeat without result
words.example: La ședință, colegul bătea apa în piuă.
words.exampleMeaning: At the meeting, the colleague was talking pointlessly.

words.meaning: literal: to cut leaves for dogs; real: to waste time doing nothing useful
words.example: În vacanță nu vreau să tai frunze la câini.
words.exampleMeaning: On vacation I do not want to waste time doing nothing.

words.meaning: literal: to pull out of jumps; real: to drive someone crazy or annoy badly
words.example: Zgomotul de afară mă scoate din sărite.
words.exampleMeaning: The noise outside drives me crazy.

words.word: a avea ac de cojocul cuiva
words.reading: ah ah-veh-ah ak deh ko-zho-kool koo-ee-vah
words.meaning: literal: to have a needle for someone's sheepskin coat; real: to know how to deal with someone
words.example: Bunica are ac de cojocul oricărui copil obraznic.
words.exampleMeaning: Grandma knows how to handle any naughty child.

words.word: a se da de ceasul morții
words.reading: ah seh dah deh chah-sool mor-tsee
words.meaning: literal: to give oneself to the clock of death; real: to worry frantically
words.example: Mama se dă de ceasul morții când întârziem.
words.exampleMeaning: Mom worries frantically when we are late.

words.word: a fi cu capul în nori
words.reading: ah fee koo kah-pool uhn nor
words.meaning: literal: to be with one's head in the clouds; real: to be dreamy or distracted
words.example: Fratele meu e mereu cu capul în nori.
words.exampleMeaning: My brother always has his head in the clouds.

words.meaning: literal: to make with the eye; real: to wink or be tempting
words.example: Oferta aceea îmi face cu ochiul.
words.exampleMeaning: That offer looks tempting to me.

words.meaning: literal: to put straw on the fire; real: to make a conflict worse
words.example: Comentariul lui a pus paie pe foc.
words.exampleMeaning: His comment added fuel to the fire.

words.meaning: literal: to take over the leg; real: to mock or tease someone
words.example: Nu mă lua peste picior când întreb ceva.
words.exampleMeaning: Do not mock me when I ask something.

words.meaning: literal: to give oneself beaten; real: to give up
words.example: Nu te da bătut după prima încercare.
words.exampleMeaning: Do not give up after the first try.

words.meaning: literal: to catch courage; real: to gain courage
words.example: După primul succes, am prins curaj.
words.exampleMeaning: After the first success, I gained courage.

items.hint: to add fuel to the fire
